response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff individual contributor with ~15 years of hands-on engineering across backend, web, mobile and embedded, plus genuine low-latency distributed-systems exposure at Sociomantic/dunnhumby. However, the role is an executive CTO position and the resume shows no evidence of the core hard requirements: no engineering management or team scaling (10 → 30+), no senior-leadership layer development, no board/exec communication, no vendor/outsourcing governance, and no production multi-agent AI systems or LLM evaluation/observability work beyond recent MCP tooling contributions. Fintech exposure is limited to one engineering role at RIDE Capital, without credit-risk, liquidity, or regulated AI systems ownership. The gap between IC craftsman and venture-backed scale-up CTO is too wide for this search.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering across 15+ years and many stacks
Real distributed/low-latency microservices experience (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Early agentic exposure via MCP code generators and AI-agent tooling at re:cinq
concerns: No engineering leadership or team-scaling track record; purely IC titles
No production multi-agent AI systems, evaluation, or LLM infra ownership
Minimal fintech/regulated-domain depth (no credit, risk, or compliance systems)

key_factors.factor: Lack of executive/leadership and team-scaling experience
No production agentic AI systems ownership
Strong distributed-systems and backend engineering depth
